description: Search the Opus Motion catalog of promo and launch video templates. Returns each template's id, title, description, tier and price, length, formats and example brands. Use it to find a template for someone's launch, product or brand video. Pro templates (every layer editable) are listed by list_pro_templates.

format.description: Only templates offered in this format.

query.description: One or two words: a use, a style or a brand (for example 'launch' or 'music app'). Leave it out to see every template.

tier.description: Only free or only premium templates.

name: search_templates
title: Search video templates
